Inspect this P&ID and identify the equipment and process elements that are clearly visible. Highlight anything that cannot be confidently identified.

{
  "description": "<concise description>",
  "findings": ["<observable fact (verified|probable|uncertain)>"],
  "entities": ["<named object/equipment/tag (status)>"],
  "uncertain_items": ["<unclear item (uncertain|not_visible|conflict)>"]
}
Stop immediately after the closing brace.
